bundle.shortDescription: Self-contained Windows desktop media archiver for Instagram Reels, photos, carousels, and stories
bundle.longDescription: InstaFlow is a commercial-grade, self-contained Windows desktop client built on Tauri v2 and Rust that manages standalone yt-dlp, gallery-dl, and FFmpeg binaries to archive permitted Instagram media in original highest quality.
